name: Employee
description: Store employee information and organizational hierarchy for leave management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the employee

fields.name: email
fields.description: Employee's work email address

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department the employee belongs to

fields.name: position
fields.description: Job title or position of the employee

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the employee's direct manager for approval routing

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Employment status indicating if employee is currently active

fields.name: hireDate
fields.description: Date when the employee joined the organization

constraints.email: Must be a valid email format and unique across all employees
constraints.managerId: Must reference a valid employee ID or be null for top-level employees

name: LeaveType
description: Define available leave types and their configuration rules

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave type

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the leave type (e.g., Annual, Sick, Personal, Unpaid)

fields.name: isPaid
fields.description: Indicates whether this leave type is paid or unpaid

fields.name: requiresDocumentation
fields.description: Indicates if supporting documentation is required for approval

fields.name: maxDaysPerYear
fields.description: Maximum number of days allowed per year for this leave type

fields.name: accrualRate
fields.description: Number of days accrued per month (for leave types with accrual)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this leave type is currently active and available for use

constraints.maxDaysPerYear: Must be a positive number if specified
constraints.accrualRate: Must be a positive number if specified

name: AuditLog
description: Maintains comprehensive audit trail of all system actions including request submissions, status changes, approvals, and balance updates for compliance and troubleshooting

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user who performed the action

fields.name: actionType
fields.description: Type of action performed (e.g., REQUEST_SUBMITTED, STATUS_CHANGED, APPROVED, REJECTED, BALANCE_UPDATED)

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (e.g., LeaveRequest, Employee, LeaveBalance)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the entity that was affected by the action

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before and after values of changed fields

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the action was performed

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

relationships.description: Links to the employee who performed the action

indexes.name: idx_audit_user_timestamp
indexes.description: Optimizes queries filtering by user and time range

indexes.name: idx_audit_entity
indexes.description: Optimizes queries for retrieving audit history of specific entities

indexes.name: idx_audit_action_timestamp
indexes.description: Optimizes queries filtering by action type and time range

constraints.retentionPolicy: Retain for minimum 7 years for compliance purposes

name: LeaveBalance
description: Track available leave balances for each employee by leave type

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave balance record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this leave balance

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave this balance tracks

fields.name: accruedDays
fields.description: Total number of leave days accrued or allocated

fields.name: usedDays
fields.description: Number of leave days already taken and approved

fields.name: pendingDays
fields.description: Number of leave days in pending approval requests

fields.name: availableDays
fields.description: Number of leave days currently available (accrued - used - pending)

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of the last balance update

relationships.description: Each leave balance belongs to one employee
Each leave balance is associated with one leave type

indexes.name: idx_employee_leavetype
indexes.description: Ensure one balance record per employee per leave type

indexes.name: idx_employee
indexes.description: Quick lookup of all leave balances for an employee

constraints.uniqueEmployeeLeaveType: An employee can have only one balance record per leave type
constraints.nonNegativeValues: All day values (accrued, used, pending, available) must be non-negative
constraints.balanceCalculation: availableDays should equal accruedDays - usedDays - pendingDays

name: LeaveRequest
description: Central entity capturing all leave request information including employee, leave type, dates, duration, reason, current status, and workflow stage

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave request

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee submitting the leave request

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave being requested

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: durationDays
fields.description: Total number of days requested for leave

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Employee's reason or justification for the leave request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current approval status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)

relationships.description: Leave request belongs to an employee
Leave request is of a specific leave type

indexes.description: Optimize queries for employee's requests by status
Optimize queries for leave requests within date ranges

constraints.endDateAfterStartDate: endDate must be greater than or equal to startDate
constraints.validStatus: status must be one of: pending, approved, rejected, cancelled

name: ApprovalAction
description: Records individual approval or rejection actions in the leave request workflow, providing a complete audit trail of decisions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval action

fields.name: leaveRequestId
fields.description: Reference to the leave request being acted upon

fields.name: approverId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who performed the approval action

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action taken: approved, rejected, or pending

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Workflow stage: manager_review or hr_review

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Optional comments or reason for the decision

fields.name: actionDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the action was taken

relationships.description: Each approval action belongs to one leave request
Each approval action is performed by one employee

name: NotificationQueue
description: Queue and track email notifications for reliable delivery with retry logic and status tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the recipient

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email subject line

fields.name: body
fields.description: Email body content (HTML or plain text)

fields.name: templateUsed
fields.description: Name or identifier of the email template used

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status: pending, sent, failed, retrying

fields.name: attemptCount
fields.description: Number of send attempts made

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was queued

name: LeaveCalendar
description: Aggregates approved leave requests into calendar format for team visibility and resource planning

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the calendar entry

fields.name: leaveRequestId
fields.description: Reference to the approved leave request

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee on leave

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Department identifier for filtering and team visibility

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the calendar entry (active, cancelled, completed)

relationships.description: Links to the approved leave request
Links to the employee on leave
Links to the type of leave

indexes.name: idx_leave_calendar_dates
indexes.description: Optimizes queries for date range searches

indexes.name: idx_leave_calendar_department
indexes.description: Optimizes team and department calendar views

uniqueConstraints.description: Each approved leave request appears only once in the calendar

checkConstraints.name: valid_date_range
checkConstraints.description: End date must be on or after start date
